-- STD-016 · generated from the card contract · non-normative
WITH denominator AS (
  SELECT record_id FROM findings
  WHERE severity = 'critical'
    AND internet_facing = TRUE
    AND due_at >= :period_start AND due_at < :period_end
    AND scope_id = :scope_id
),
numerator AS (
  SELECT f.record_id
  FROM findings f JOIN denominator USING (record_id)
  WHERE f.remediated_at <= f.due_at
    AND f.validation_status = 'validated'
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM denominator) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM numerator)
             / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM denominator)
END AS sla_compliance_pct;

// STD-016 · generated from the card contract · non-normative
SLA Compliance % :=
VAR BaseFindings =
    FILTER (
        Findings,
        Findings[severity] = "critical"
            && Findings[internet_facing] = TRUE ()
            && Findings[due_at] >= [Period Start]
            && Findings[due_at] < [Period End]
            && Findings[scope_id] = [Selected Scope]
    )
VAR Due = COUNTROWS ( BaseFindings )
VAR WithinSLA =
    COUNTROWS (
        FILTER (
            BaseFindings,
            Findings[remediated_at] <= Findings[due_at]
                && Findings[validation_status] = "validated"
        )
    )
RETURN
    IF ( Due = 0, BLANK (), DIVIDE ( 100 * WithinSLA, Due ) )

# STD-016 · generated from the card contract · non-normative
import pandas as pd

def sla_compliance_pct(findings: pd.DataFrame,
                       period_start, period_end, scope_id):
    base = findings[
        (findings["severity"] == "critical")
        & (findings["internet_facing"])
        & (findings["due_at"] >= period_start)
        & (findings["due_at"] < period_end)
        & (findings["scope_id"] == scope_id)
    ]
    due = len(base)
    if due == 0:
        return None                      # n/a - never 0
    within_sla = (
        (base["remediated_at"] <= base["due_at"])
        & (base["validation_status"] == "validated")
    ).sum()
    return 100.0 * within_sla / due
